title: 拼豆流程
From pattern to keepsake
patternIntro: 先在小红书上搜索拼豆图纸，可以找自己喜欢的 ip 或者风格。图纸示例：
Search Xiaohongshu for a bead pattern featuring a character or style you like. Here is an example:
patternDetail:
图纸右下角会显示占用格子数，可推测拼豆成品大小（40×40 格子约 10.7cm）。
图纸下方会显示颜色及豆子数量。
可多保存几个拼豆图，以便拼豆时使用。

The grid dimensions at the bottom right help you estimate the finished size: a 40 × 40 grid is about 10.7 cm.
The colours and bead counts appear beneath the pattern.
Save a few patterns to choose from when you arrive.
toolsBody:
如果是第一次拼，店主会详细介绍拼豆工具如何使用，包你上手！
当然也可以提前了解一下：

If this is your first time, the host will show you how to use each tool and help you get started!
You can also take a look before your visit:
toolsLink: A closer look at the tools
makingBody:
咱们是一组客人一套拼豆，所以不用先找颜色，直接上手开始拼就好啦！
拼豆时先拼外框，可以理解为先描边；
再拼数量较少的颜色；
最后大面积铺色。

Each group has its own set of beads, so you can start right away without gathering colours first!
Begin with the outline.
Then place the colours used in smaller quantities.
Fill the larger areas last.
choicesTitle: Choose a finish and a keepsake
choicesBody:
拼好后交给店主，选择喜欢的纹理烫。
然后考虑一下做成什么东西吧！无论是挂件还是冰箱贴，所有手工制品都由店主免费制作，只有较为复杂的款式需额外收费。
最后店主会认真把成品包装好交给你喔！

When you finish, hand your pegboard to the host and pick the ironing texture you like.
Then decide what to make! Whether a charm or a fridge magnet, the host makes every keepsake for free; only more complex designs cost extra.
Finally, the host will carefully package your creation for you!
ironingBody: 告知店主喜欢的纹理烫，将拼好的豆板交给店主即可！店主烫好后会还给你，来欣赏你的萌作吧！
Tell the host which ironing texture you like and hand over your finished pegboard. The host will iron it for you—then it is time to admire your creation!
finishingBody: 无论是挂件还是冰箱贴，所有手工制品都由店主免费制作！只有较为复杂的款式需额外收费，店主届时会提前告知喔。
Whether you choose a charm or a fridge magnet, the host will put it together for free! Only more complex designs cost extra, and the host will let you know beforehand.
packaging: 最后店主会认真把成品包装起来喔！
Finally, the host will carefully package your finished creation!
booked: 如果已提交预约，期待我们的见面！
Already sent your reservation? We look forward to meeting you!
notBooked: 如果还未预约，准备来大展身手了吗？
